summary: The upload page has a Max views option, the upload client sends it as the views field, and scripts/pb has --views N. The display page shows "Remaining views: N" for a limited paste and "Remaining views: unlimited" otherwise, in the server-rendered page and the React page. doc/api.md documents views, maxViews, and viewsRemaining.

intent.objective: Let users set a view limit on upload (web page, upload client, and CLI) and see the remaining views on the display page. Document the views field.

assumptions.rationale: The upload page, the upload client, and scripts/pb send the view limit in the views form field.
The display page reads viewsRemaining from the paste metadata. Without it, the page shows unlimited.

preservedInvariants: The upload form sends no views field when the option is empty.
The display page renders on the server for unencrypted pastes.
Existing upload fields and their meaning do not change.
